explain.title: Why this advance and this delivery charge
explain.sub: From the order's own records. Read it out or copy it when a customer asks.

state.not-set: Not fixed yet: confirm on the call

explain.say: What to say to the customer
explain.sayNone: Nothing to explain: no advance and no delivery charge.

why.none: No advance was asked: the order is Cash on Delivery.
why.chosePrepaid: No advance was asked: the customer chose to pay online.
why.layer: The checkout's advance rule "{name}" matched this customer.
why.checkoutRule: The checkout's advance rules asked for it when the order was placed.
why.gift: A gift: gift mode takes the whole amount ahead, so the receiver pays nothing at the door.
why.giftPart: A gift: gift mode takes a part ahead; the rest is paid at the door.
why.codOffBand: Cash on Delivery was not offered: the order was over the COD limit of the {band} band ({limit}).
why.codOffRule: Cash on Delivery was not offered: a Smart Rule turned it off for this order.
why.codOffShop: Cash on Delivery was switched off for the shop when he ordered.
why.deliveryNotFull: Only the delivery charge is taken ahead, not the full amount: it covers the courier's trip if the parcel is refused, and the rest is paid at the door.
why.fullNotDelivery: The full amount is taken ahead, not only the delivery charge: the rule that matched is the strict one.
why.dueBy: To be paid by {at}. After that someone is asked to call; the order is never cancelled by itself.
why.noRecord: The order waits for an advance, but no reason was recorded for it.
why.band: {charge}: the charge of the {band} band, as the customer saw it at checkout.
why.viaLineNoPlace: The band was read from the address he typed.
why.viaChoice: The customer picked "{band}" himself when the page asked inside or outside.
why.viaSaved: His number is known: the band came from the address we hold for him (nothing was shown to him).
why.placeUnsure: The exact place was not certain; the band was.
why.backfill: The full address we hold was attached for packing.
why.bandNow: The band charges {now} today; the order keeps the {charge} he was shown.
why.detailCheck: The address has no house or road in it: the confirmation call asks for directions.
why.freeOver: Free delivery: the order is over the free-delivery amount ({over}).
why.freeCampaign: Free delivery: a free-delivery offer was running.
why.freeProducts: Free delivery: the bag held products that ship free.
why.freePrepaid: Free delivery: the reward for paying online.
why.exempt: Free delivery is exempt from the band checks: no band question, correction or message applies.
why.unclear: The address could not be placed, so the charge is not fixed: confirm the place and the charge on the call.
why.notSet: The {band} band had no charge set when he ordered: confirm the charge on the call.
why.notSetNoBand: No delivery charge was set when he ordered: confirm the charge on the call.
why.pickup: A showroom or pickup order: there is no delivery charge.
